skills.profile: Specialist Java native-memory design, migration and diagnosis skill. Activates for direct-buffer/native growth, RSS diverging from heap, off-heap ownership failures and Unsafe migration, while whole-process budgets, heap retention and native call ABI work have separate owners. It supports API/lifetime reviews with source evidence as well as measured growth investigations; it does not force runtime captures on narrow API explanations. FFM examples require stable Java 22+ with no implied project upgrade; HotSpot/tool implementation claims are scoped to the stated JDK25 and async-profiler4.0 baselines.

Make consumer retention and asynchronous handoff decisive when choosing borrowing, shared ownership scope or existing library storage.
Separate direct-buffer capacity limits, FFM/native allocations, NMT coverage and resident/cgroup evidence; no flat metric proves absence of native growth.
Use off-heap only when complete-path measurements or an explicit lifetime/interoperability requirement justify its costs; preserve adequate existing implementations.
